source_anchors.meaning: Run-global flag defaults to enabled; no input option sets it.
Release-mass threshold used by the species count.
Only mutation: run-wide disable when MQUASILAG with nspec>1, or any release point has more than one species above eps2.
f32 placement epsilon used by the ordinary upper action.
Every advance call starts with nstop false and zero settling; stickiness is bounded by one advance call.
Only a horizontal domain-exit stop returns before the upper action and correction.
First upper action, applied to the predictor position.
Correction gates do not test nstop; a boundary-set stop still corrects.
Predictor velocity: first carrier above eps3; get_settling only for density>0; forward-only ground clamp; added to w.
Adaptive PBL substeps also call the upper action (unsupported route).
Corrector samples the advanced signed time at the stored predictor position, which is retained above the top after a stop.
Settling recomputed at the predictor position and added before differencing.
Half-difference correction of the stored predictor, then the second upper action.
Horizontal domain exit is a distinct stop cause (out of #203 scope).
Inclusive test; backward with flag sets nstop and retains z; otherwise ordinary placement. Never clears nstop.

tokens: if (nstop1.gt.1) error stop 'NO METEO FIELDS AVAILABLE'
source_anchors.meaning: Missing meteorology is a run failure, never a particle fate.
A stopped particle skips partpos_avg and calcfluxes.
After the parallel loop every flagged live particle is terminated before deposition/decay.
Deposition/decay/age loop iterates only live particles.
Termination changes liveness only; mass and position are not modified or deposited.
Backward initial-condition attribution includes only live particles.
Gridded concentration/sensitivity output includes only live particles.
get_settling uses nearest-column T/rho from memory slot 1 with linear vertical interpolation that extrapolates above the top level.

status_vocabulary.supported_current: Current production behavior is covered by existing accepted evidence.
status_vocabulary.rejected_current: Explicitly rejected before release/encoding today and must remain rejected until the named owner delivers.
status_vocabulary.implementation_blocked: Semantics are frozen here; device implementation belongs to the #214.
status_vocabulary.oracle_blocked: No genuine pinned row exists; values must come from a new genuine oracle extension, never from this matrix.
status_vocabulary.producer_blocked: Requires an accepted nonzero settling-velocity producer and production coupling (#35/#37).
status_vocabulary.unsupported_route: Outside the supported envelope; existing rejection or exclusion is preserved.
status_vocabulary.not_reachable_in_original: The original control flow cannot produce this state; the GPU must make it unrepresentable or fatal.

gpu_classifications.success_no_stop: All status words zero; lane published live.
gpu_classifications.success_scientific_stop: All status words zero; lane published with FLAG_ACTIVE cleared and its advection-stage state retained.
gpu_classifications.host_reject_invalid_settling_input: Typed host error before release/encoding; particle bytes untouched.
gpu_classifications.host_reject_missing_producer: Typed host error before release/encoding; particle bytes untouched.
gpu_classifications.host_reject_unsupported_configuration: Typed host error before release/encoding; particle bytes untouched.
gpu_classifications.host_reject_context_or_identity: Typed host error before encoding; particle bytes untouched.
gpu_classifications.device_fatal_meteorology: A sample/preparation status region is fatal; no lane or stop word is published.
gpu_classifications.device_fatal_settling_producer: The settling producer status region is fatal; no lane or stop word is published.
gpu_classifications.device_fatal_arithmetic: The corrected-arithmetic word is fatal; no lane or stop word is published.
gpu_classifications.not_reachable: State must be unrepresentable by construction.

cases.title: Forward transport, settling disabled

original.branch: ldirect=1: ordinary set_z(height(nz)-100*eps) at both actions

evidence.surface: Existing #198 real-driver transport-top matrix (both drivers).

cases.title: Backward transport, settling disabled

original.branch: ldirect=-1 with lsettling false: ordinary placement

evidence.surface: Existing #198 matrix. Valid only when the run genuinely derives lsettling=.false. (see C20/C21).

cases.title: Backward, settling enabled, zero instantaneous velocity

original.branch: lsettling true but selected carrier density<=0: velocity stays 0, stop predicate still active

cases.predictor: no velocity term; z>=top sets stop and retains z
cases.corrector: executes from retained z; z>=top sets stop and retains z

evidence.oracle_gap: No public-advance row combines lsettling=.true. with a density<=0 carrier.
evidence.surface: Follow-up real-driver matrix, backward driver, software and hardware WGSL.

original.branch: get_settling at current and predictor positions; w+settling; stop at top

cases.predictor: w+vs moves above top; stop; z retained
cases.corrector: executes with vs recomputed at retained predictor; stop remains

evidence.surface: Real #35 kernel fed by recorded #180 T/rho controls through the backward driver; production enablement waits for the producer.

cases.title: Predictor crosses above the top

cases.corrector: executes from the raw retained predictor

evidence.oracle_gap: Scenario 6 lacks the flag; scenario 9 needs a nonzero producer.

original.branch: first action passes; second action stops and retains corrected z

evidence.surface: Follow-up real-driver matrix.

evidence.surface: Follow-up real-driver matrix.
